opening_message:
Ticket 1: Richard Davis (employee ID E011) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E011.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. He requested write access to Payroll. Full-time employees may have up to write access; his role owns the Payroll system. Recommend write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (not looked up in own database before writing; same value as note 1 by HR agent)
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security record for E011 (Richard Davis) shows contractor with basic security training. Contractors without advanced training may have read at most; requested write exceeds max, so recommend read.
reason: Employee E011 (Richard Davis) requested write access to Payroll. There is conflicting employment-type information: HR lists full_time, but the Security agent verified in its own database that E011 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training (no advanced security training) may have at most read access — write exceeds the maximum, so I grant the maximum permitted level: read.

- security training: basic

There's a conflict: HR says full_time, Security says contractor.

The access policy:
1. full_time employees: up to write. Admin only if role owns system.
2. contractor employees: read, or write if advanced security training. Never admin.

If full_time Payroll Specialist: max is write (role owns system, so admin possible, but max for full-time is write unless... actually policy says full_time up to write, admin only if role owns system. So full-time Payroll Specialist could get admin at most, but requested write -> grant write).
